title: I Long for a Human Being
hook: An old man walked through town in daylight, holding a lamp. What was he looking for?

segments.fa: دی شیخ با چراغ همی گشت گرد شهر
segments.en: Yesterday the sheikh went round the town with a lamp,

segments.fa: کز دیو و دد ملولم و انسانم آرزوست
segments.en: saying: I am tired of demons and beasts. I long for a human being.

segments.fa: گفت آنک یافت می‌نشود آنم آرزوست
segments.en: He said: the one who cannot be found, that is the one I long for.

tafsir: People told him: we have searched. Such a person cannot be found.
And he answered with the last line.
Rumi is not talking about crowds. He means a true human being, awake and kind.
For Rumi, that search ended in Konya, the day he met Shams.
Maybe the lamp is still in our hands.

outro.say: This is the longing behind our serial, Shams and Rumi. Follow The Guest House.
outro.title: Shams & Rumi · the serial on our page
